method_note: Public web research only (WebSearch + WebFetch of public pages). No logins bypassed. Ontario Basketball's own 'Find a Club' directory (basketball.on.ca/find-a-club/) renders its per-region club lists via client-side JavaScript tabs that a static fetch cannot see — flagged below as the single highest-value unresolved target. Every club below was corroborated by at least one fetched or search-indexed page; the evidence_url is where the name/city/type was actually seen.

directories.name: Ontario Basketball Association – Find a Club
directories.notes: Confirmed structure: 8 regional tabs (West Region, Hamilton-Niagara Region, North Region, Kitchener-Waterloo Region, Toronto Region, Durham-York, Peel-Halton, Capital-Kingston) covering ~175-180 affiliated clubs/associations per OBA's own public statements. The actual club listings inside each tab load via JavaScript and were NOT retrievable through static WebFetch (tool returned only the page shell/nav both times, including a second attempt explicitly hunting for embedded JSON). This is almost certainly where most of Ontario's community layer is enumerated by OBA itself. Needs a browser-automation fetch (e.g. Playwright) to click each regional tab and scrape the DOM after render.

directories.name: Ontario Basketball Association – Find an Affiliated Club or Camp Info
directories.notes: Single club-profile template page (Sports Savvy, Dundas ON) rendered with mostly placeholder/Lorem-ipsum fields — appears to be an individual listing detail page in the same club-directory system as 'Find a Club', reached via a per-club ID/slug not discovered in this sweep.

directories.name: Ontario Basketball Association – Registered Teams
directories.notes: Filter UI (Club / Age Group / Gender) that hands off to an external SportsAvvy-powered registration portal; no static list of club names visible.

directories.name: Ontario Basketball Association – Annual Reports (PDF archive)
directories.notes: PDF annual reports (e.g. 2022-23, 2018-19) exist and were located but not opened/read in this sweep. OBA states ~175-180 affiliated clubs/year; these reports may contain an appendix roster of every affiliated club — a promising unread source.

directories.name: 211 Ontario (211ontario.ca) community services directory
directories.notes: The single most productive general directory found. Individual org records are indexed and fetchable (Guelph Youth Basketball Association, Kitchener-Waterloo Youth Basketball Association, Grimsby Basketball Association, Chatham-Kent Wildcats, Orillia Youth Basketball Association, Pelham Panthers Basketball Association, etc. all confirmed this way). However, direct in-site search (https://211ontario.ca/search/?q=basketball) returned only a bot-check/'Verification' interstitial to WebFetch — could not bulk-browse. All yields here came from targeted WebSearch queries of the form 'site:211ontario.ca basketball', which almost certainly only surfaced a fraction of what 211's ~60,000-record province-wide database actually holds under its Basketball/Youth Sports category.

directories.name: CIOC / OpenCIOC regional community-information network (peel.cioc.ca, halton.cioc.ca, niagara.cioc.ca, centraleastontario.cioc.ca, regionofwaterloo.cioc.ca, infobarrie.cioc.ca, simcoecounty.cioc.ca, orillia.cioc.ca, info-bhn.cioc.ca, etc.)
directories.notes: Legacy 211-affiliated regional directories, one per county/region, each with its own 'bresults.asp?SubjID=NNN' basketball-category search. Peel's (peel.cioc.ca/bresults.asp?SubjID=186) worked and returned 6 results (2 genuine clubs + 2 municipal rec centres + 1 unrelated soccer centre + 1 satellite youth-outreach office), confirming the mechanism but showing thin/inconsistent tagging (it missed known Peel clubs like Team Breakdown and Monarchs). The same SubjID guessed against Halton, Niagara, Central-East Ontario, and Waterloo Region either returned 'no records' or 302-redirected to www.cioc.ca root, indicating those regional instances are being sunset/merged into 211ontario.ca. Individual record pages (not the category search) still resolve fine on several of these subdomains.

directories.name: Sudbury SportLink
directories.notes: City-specific community-sport directory site (comparable model to basketball604.com but multi-sport and single-city). Only one basketball entry surfaced via search; the site's own basketball or full-directory category page was not located/fetched. Worth a direct crawl — other Ontario cities may run similar 'SportLink'-branded directories not yet checked.

directories.name: Total Sports Quinte – Basketball directory category
directories.notes: Regional sports-media business directory for the Belleville/Quinte/Trenton area. Returned 6 basketball-tagged listings, but most are competitive/travel clubs (Belleville Spirits) or municipal/military recreation (PSP Community Recreation at CFB Trenton, Wheelchair Basketball Quinte) rather than house-league community associations — suggests the true Quinte community layer sits elsewhere (municipal program guides, school gyms) and is under-indexed here.

directories.name: Ottawa Valley Basketball Association of Basketball Officials – Links & Partners page
directories.notes: An officials' association (not itself a youth club) whose partner-links page functions as a de facto small directory of Ottawa/Eastern-Ontario community basketball associations (Kanata, Gloucester-Cumberland, Nepean, West Ottawa, Ottawa Shooting Stars, Ottawa South, plus the Eastern Ontario Basketball League and Naismith Basketball Association). High-value low-volume find.

directories.name: Niagara District Basketball [Referees/Officials] Association – links page
directories.notes: Site serves over an obsolete/unsupported TLS configuration — WebFetch failed with 'UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL'. Surfaced only in search snippets; never actually read. Likely a dead or near-dead site but worth one more try via a plain browser/curl with legacy TLS allowed.

directories.name: Jr. NBA Canada – Find a Community / Find Your Program
directories.notes: This was expected to be Ontario's equivalent of the Saskatchewan TeamLinkt SKY Basketball communities page (which yielded 27 clubs there). Fetched twice under different URLs (jrnba.ca/find-your-program and the ecrew.ca locator referenced from a search snippet, nba.ecrew.ca/index.php?type=RE&loc=en&doprovince=ON&v=d) — the jrnba.ca page is a template with no populated results in static HTML, and nba.ecrew.ca failed outright with a DNS error (domain does not currently resolve). This remains the biggest gap against angle #6 of the brief; needs either a working current URL for the Jr NBA Canada host-site locator or a JS-rendering fetch of jrnba.ca's results widget.

directories.name: Ontario Basketball Association – Community programs page (Jr. NBA, Mega Hoops, 3x3, OSDP, Midnight Basketball, Lay-Up Camp)
directories.notes: Lists OBA's own community-facing programs and names two Toronto community partners (Lay-Up Youth Basketball Camp, Midnight Basketball) but is a program-description page, not a club directory.

coverage_assessment: This sweep found and verified 80 distinct community/house-league/rec/municipal/YMCA/parish basketball organizations across essentially every populated region of Ontario (Toronto's old boroughs, Peel, Halton, York, Durham, Hamilton-Niagara, Waterloo Region, London/SW Ontario, Windsor-Essex, Ottawa/Eastern Ontario, Simcoe/Barrie/Orillia, and Sudbury), plus 12 directories/aggregators of varying usefulness. That is a real, non-trivial layer where the prior Ontario list had zero. But I do not believe this is close to the true universe. Reasoning: (1) Ontario Basketball's own site states it affiliates ~175-180 clubs/associations a year, and its 'Find a Club' directory — which almost certainly contains a large fraction of the true count — could not be scraped because its listings are JavaScript-rendered; none of those specific club names were captured here except by lucky independent discovery. (2) OBA-affiliation itself is not exhaustive — several house leagues in this list (e.g. small parish leagues, some municipal programs) plausibly never affiliate with OBA at all, closer to how BC/Prairie community associations sit outside their provincial federation's elite pathway. (3) Ontario has roughly 444 municipalities and dozens of mid-size cities/towns not touched at all in this sweep (e.g. Peterborough, Cornwall proper, Pembroke, Renfrew, Haliburton, Bracebridge/Muskoka towns, Parry Sound, Elliot Lake, Kenora, Sioux Lookout, most of Northwestern Ontario, and dozens of GTA-adjacent small towns) — basketball house leagues likely exist in many of these but have thin-to-nonexistent indexed web presence (Facebook-only, or folded into a multi-sport 'minor sports association'). (4) Parish/CYO leagues are almost certainly badly under-counted: general web search surfaces overwhelmingly US Catholic Youth Organization content for 'CYO basketball,' and Ontario parish leagues (Toronto Archdiocese, Hamilton Diocese, London Diocese) were only found where a specific parish name was already known (Blessed Sacrament, St. Catharines, Brantford, London) — diocesan sports-office pages were never reached directly. (5) YMCA Ontario branches (~30+ locations) were only lightly touched (Ottawa, general references) — branch-by-branch basketball program confirmation was not done. Rough honest estimate: the true Ontario community/rec/house-league basketball universe is very likely 250-450+ organizations (roughly proportional to Ontario's ~40% share of Canada's population weighed against the other provinces' community-layer percentages), meaning this sweep has likely captured somewhere in the 15-27% range of the true universe — a solid seed list, not a census.
next_best_sources: Browser-automation (Playwright/headless-browser) scrape of basketball.on.ca/find-a-club/ clicking through all 8 regional tabs — single highest-value unresolved target, likely the closest thing to an authoritative ~175-180-club roster
Open and OCR/parse the OBA 2022-23 and 2018-19 Annual Report PDFs (basketball.on.ca/wp-content/uploads/.../*.pdf) for an affiliated-club appendix

211ontario.ca full-text search via an actual browser session (not raw query-string WebFetch, which hit a bot-check interstitial) to enumerate its Basketball/Youth Sports category province-wide rather than relying on piecemeal 'site:211ontario.ca' Google queries

Municipal parks & recreation seasonal 'Activity Guide' PDFs for City of Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Hamilton, Ottawa, London, Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill — these typically list every community-run house league that has a standing gym permit, which is exactly the segment missed here

Diocesan sports/CYO office pages for the Archdiocese of Toronto, Diocese of Hamilton, and Diocese of London directly (not general web search, which is swamped by US CYO results) to get full parish-league rosters
City-specific 'SportLink'-style aggregator sites (confirmed one exists for Sudbury at sudburysportlink.ca) — worth checking whether London, Windsor, Ottawa, or other mid-size cities run an equivalent

Facebook Page search by city name + 'basketball' + 'minor'/'house league' — several confirmed clubs in this sweep (East York, WOMBA, Sarnia Valhalla, NGBA) have Facebook as their most current/primary web presence, suggesting many more community leagues exist there and nowhere else indexable by general web search

YMCA of Ontario branch-by-branch site check (YMCA of Greater Toronto, YMCA of Hamilton/Burlington/Brantford, YMCA of Southwestern Ontario, YMCA of Eastern Ontario, YMCA of Northeastern Ontario) for basketball-specific programming, only lightly touched this round

Direct outreach/search for Northwestern and far-Northern Ontario (Thunder Bay, Kenora, Sioux Lookout, Timmins, North Bay) minor basketball associations — this sweep surfaced almost nothing there and those communities were not confirmed one way or the other
